titlePlain: Setting Up the dbt Project and Connecting to
subtitle: Lesson 4 · Chapter 1: First dbt Model on Snowflake

code:
dbt init jaffle_shop_capstone

# dbt_project.yml
name: 'jaffle_shop_capstone'
version: '1.0.0'
profile: 'jaffle_shop_capstone'
model-paths: ["models"]
caption: profile: is a name, not a connection — the real credentials live elsewhere.

code:
# ~/.dbt/profiles.yml — never inside the project
jaffle_shop_capstone:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: snowflake
      account: your_account.snowflakecomputing.com
      user: your_username
      database: jaffle_shop_raw
      schema: dbt_yourname
caption: database: jaffle_shop_raw — the exact database Lesson 3 loaded raw_customers into.
